summary_en: Ichigo Inc. authorized acquisition of up to 15 million shares (3.83% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 5 billion yen through broker-assisted trading from October 15, 2026 to April 30, 2027, marking the 10th consecutive year of buyback implementation.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Own Shares and Cancellation of Own Shares
translation_en_brief:
On October 14, 2026, Ichigo Inc.'s board of directors authorized the acquisition of up to 15 million shares of its own common stock, representing a maximum of 3.83% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026. The acquisition budget is capped at 5 billion yen, with the acquisition period running from October 15, 2026 to April 30, 2027. The company will conduct the acquisition through broker-assisted trading, where a securities firm will handle purchases at its discretion.

This authorization marks the 10th consecutive year of share buyback implementation by Ichigo. The company stated that the acquisition is intended to enhance shareholder value by taking into account the market price of the company's shares and its financial condition. Prior acquisitions authorized on November 6, 2025 and January 14, 2026 had a combined budget ceiling of 10 billion yen, of which 5.1 billion yen was spent during the current fiscal year, with that program now fully executed.

The company plans to cancel shares acquired under this authorization in three tranches: 14 million shares previously held as treasury stock will be cancelled on October 30, 2026; shares acquired between October 15, 2026 and January 31, 2027 will be cancelled on February 19, 2027; and shares acquired from February 1, 2027 onward will be cancelled on May 21, 2027. The exact number of shares in the latter two tranches will be announced once acquisition is complete.
